d:
A massive, centipede-like insect species with a segmented, chitinous exoskeleton of deep ochre and rusted brown. Features dozens of sharp, jointed legs and a menacing head with multifaceted, glowing amber eyes. A thick, segmented tail ending in a sharp, hardened spike of rusted brown. Six sharp claws on each of the two primary front limbs.
BODY COLOR: rusted brown
